title: Precision-gated model promotions using weighted eval signatures
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a precision gating service that computes "weighted eval signatures" from curated eval prompt sets (per-cohort signatures derived from embeddings + aggregated metric vectors) to decide promotions for canary/A-B/blue-green traffic. The service must: (1) ingest scorecards and per-prompt weights defined by PM/DS, (2) compute a compact signature per model and per customer-cohort, (3) continuously compare live shadow/canary outputs against signatures, and (4) trigger automated rollback or escalation when signature drift exceeds configurable thresholds. Aim is to reduce noisy false positives by weighting prompts by impact and variance and to support staged rollouts with cohort-specific thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: A lightweight signature format (<= 4KB) is defined and documented so signatures can be stored in Redis and attached to rollout metadata.
Service computes signatures from an eval set + per-prompt weights and produces a baseline signature for a model version in < 5 minutes for typical eval sets (~200 prompts).
Real-time comparator running in canary path yields a rolling drift score per cohort and will mark canary as FAILED when configured hysteresis and weighting rules are breached.
Automatic rollback workflow created: on FAIL -> block promotion, notify Slack runbook channel, create an incident in PagerDuty (if P0), and optionally revert traffic per rollout policy.
Integration with Redwood Console: per-canary dashboard shows signature delta heatmap, contributing prompts, and suggested mitigation (e.g., pin to previous model, widen fallback).
PRs for service, schema, and runtime integration merged and e2e tests added to rollout CI that simulate drift and validate rollback triggers.
milestones: Integrate comparator into canary path and shadow ingestion (2026-03-20)
implementation_notes: Signature format: vector of per-metric aggregates (mean, std, top-k token diffs) hashed plus a small metadata header (model, eval-set-id, weights-version).
Compute path: offline signature generation job (batch) + online delta comparator that consumes token-level diffs via streaming probe adapter.
Weighting: PM/DS provide per-prompt importance and acceptable variance; weights applied to aggregated deltas to compute final drift score.
Storage: signatures stored in Redis with TTL and in long-term blobstore (GCS) for audits. Ensure small payload for fast fetch in hot path.
Rollout policies: support soft-fail (alert only), hard-fail (auto-block promotion), and auto-revert with hysteresis (require N consecutive windows).
risks: False positives if eval weights are mis-specified -> mitigation: default conservative weights + dry-run for 2 cycles.
Latency impact if comparator fetches large signatures synchronously -> mitigation: cache signatures in local in-memory store per runtime node.
Operational complexity for per-customer cohorts: start with a default global cohort then add customers gradually.
Security/audit: signatures could leak customer-sensitive eval examples -> ensure encryption-at-rest and RBAC on signature retrieval.
